description: Election Commission - Declare that W. N. Kumara as a member of the Horana Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Horana Pradeshiya Sabha) due to the death of a member, as per the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the process of nominating and declaring a new elected member, which falls under electoral processes and related administrative matters for local authorities.
